theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ₁ Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ₂ Q → ∃ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ₁ α| = 1 ∧ |ξ₂ α| = 1
